decisions.reason: As a recently launched plugin closely tied to the firm's core web-mapping offer, with evident early release activity and likely low carrying costs, it remains a valuable option to keep while demand is still being learned.

This search plugin fits the established portfolio and is cheap to carry, but its lower visibility and overlap with other search-related options in a broad product range make it somewhat more exposed to pruning if uptake disappoints.

The mobile map control component addresses a clear usability need in the firm's domain and was prominent on the home page, so despite being a narrow component its uncertainty has not yet resolved enough to justify dropping it.
As a flagship GIS platform and product line aligned with the firm's stated strategic direction, it is highly likely to be retained because it anchors future offerings and customer solutions.

Mobile field data capture is close to the firm's core enterprise geospatial business and has its own dedicated presentation, so management would usually keep it, though its broader scope likely makes it costlier to carry than a simple plugin.

A search extension for web map apps is a natural adjacent add-on for this firm's installed base, and with low expected carrying costs it is worth keeping on the market until its commercial potential becomes clearer.
